schema.description: Inferred from the issuer's page (PeopleCert, 2023), visible-text sha256 206afbf8d42542934af03453bc4fe569f9a0028981e643c7baa75abf8c2d9aab: all 34 ITIL 4 practice guides share one structure, and sections 3 to 6 are titled by the Four Dimensions of Service Management. dimension.description: Four Dimensions of Service Management, as practice-guide sections 3 to 6.

practiceGuideSection.description: Practice guide sections 1 to 8: 1 About this document; 2 General information; 3 Value streams and processes; 4 Organisations and people; 5 Information and technology; 6 Partners and suppliers; 7 Important reminder; 8 Acknowledgments; the issuer adds "Capability assessment and development" and "Tips for practice success" after "Partners and suppliers" in revised guides.
